adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, the new fan-out over `event.destinationCalendar` uses a `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)` loop and performs `await prisma.credential.findUnique(...)` (when not found in memory) and then `await createEvent(credential, event, destination.externalId)` inside the loop. This makes credential lookups and calendar provider `createEvent` calls execute sequentially per destination, so a slow provider/DB call can multiply booking latency by the number of destinations. There is no concurrency bound or timeout logic shown in the diff; concurrency is only used in one branch via `Promise.all(...)`, but the outer loop is still sequential across destinations.
